examples.chinese: 我的房間不太大。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān bú tài dà.
examples.english: My room is not so big.

examples.chinese: 你的書在房間裡。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de shū zài fángjiān lǐ.
examples.english: Your book is in the room.

examples.chinese: 他在房間外面做什麼？
examples.pinyin: Tā zài fángjiān wàimiàn zuò shénme?
examples.english: What is he doing outside of the room?

examples.chinese: 你的房間裡有幾張椅子？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de fángjiān lǐ yǒu jǐ zhāng yǐzi?
examples.english: How many chairs are there in your room?

examples.chinese: 我很忙，現在要去廚房做飯，你再去房間找吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn máng, xiànzài yào qù chúfáng zuòfàn, nǐ zài qù fángjiān zhǎo ba.
examples.english: I am very busy and I am going to the kitchen to cook now. You go check your room again.

examples.chinese: 媽，我跟友美要去喝下午茶，可是我的錢包不在房間裡。
examples.pinyin: Mā, wǒ gēn Yǒuměi yào qù hē xiàwǔ chá, kěshì wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài fángjiān lǐ.
examples.english: Mom, Youmei and I are going to have afternoon tea now, but my wallet is not in the bedroom.

examples.chinese: 我很累，想在房間休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn lèi, xiǎng zài fángjiān xiūxí.
examples.english: I am tired; I want to take a rest in the room.

examples.chinese: A:你要不要去樓下的客廳看電視？ B:謝謝，我想先去樓上的房間休息。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào bù yào qù lóuxià de kètīng kàn diànshì? B: Xièxie, wǒ xiǎng xiān qù lóushàng de fángjiān xiūxi.
examples.english: A: Do you want to go to the living room downstairs to watch TV? B: Thanks, I want to go to the room upstairs to rest first.

examples.chinese:
弟弟做了一個可怕的夢，夜裡三點就醒了。
台灣的夏天熱極了，要是房間沒有冷氣，半夜可能會被熱醒，甚至整個晚上睡不著。
examples.pinyin:
Dìdi zuò le yí ge kěpà de mèng, yèlǐ sān diǎn jiù xǐng le.
Táiwān de xiàtiān rè jí le, yàoshi fángjiān méiyǒu lěngqì, bànyè kěnéng huì bèi rè xǐng, shènzhì zhěnggè wǎnshang shuì bù zháo.
examples.english:
My younger brother had a scary dream and woke up at 3 a.m.
Summers in Taiwan are extremely hot; if the room has no air conditioning, you might be woken up by the heat in the middle of the night, or even be unable to sleep all night.

examples.chinese:
現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。
這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin:
Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì.
Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english:
Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient.
This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹很會做家事，她總是把房間整理得很整齊，連窗戶也擦得很乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei hěn huì zuò jiāshì, tā zǒngshì bǎ fángjiān zhěnglǐ de hěn zhěngqí, lián chuānghu yě cā de hěn gānjìng.
examples.english: My younger sister is very good at doing housework; she always tidies up the room very neatly, and even wipes the windows very clean.

examples.chinese: 我覺得這部電影很有趣，你覺得呢？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù, nǐ juéde ne?
examples.english: I think this movie is very interesting. What do you think?

examples.chinese: 我覺得這部電影很有趣，你覺得呢 ？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù, nǐ juéde ne?
examples.english: I think this movie is very interesting. What do you think?

examples.chinese: 我覺得有一點兒累，我想回家休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒu yìdiǎnr lèi, wǒ xiǎng huí jiā xiūxí.
examples.english: I am feeling a bit tired, I want to go home for a rest.

examples.chinese: 我每天坐捷運去上課，我覺得很方便。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zuò jiéyùn qù shàngkè, wǒ juéde hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: I take the MRT to class every day; I think it's very convenient.

examples.chinese: A:我妹妹說這件衣服很好看，你覺得呢？ B:這件衣服真的很好看！
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ mèimei shuō zhè jiàn yīfu hěn hǎokàn, nǐ juéde ne? B: Zhè jiàn yīfu zhēn de hěn hǎokàn!
examples.english: A: My younger sister says this piece of clothing looks very nice; what do you think? B: This piece of clothing really looks very nice!

examples.chinese: 你覺得華語好學嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde Huáyǔ hǎo xué ma?
examples.english: Do you think Chinese is easy to learn?

examples.chinese: 以前妹妹很不喜歡穿裙子，現在她覺得穿裙子很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián mèimei hěn bù xǐhuan chuān qúnzi, xiànzài tā juéde chuān qúnzi hěn shūfu.
examples.english: In the past, my younger sister really didn't like wearing skirts; now she feels that wearing skirts is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 老師為什麼還沒來？大家都覺得很奇怪。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī wèishénme hái méi lái? Dàjiā dōu juéde hěn qíguài.
examples.english: Why hasn't the teacher come yet? Everyone feels it's very strange.

examples.chinese: A:你覺得我可以當老師嗎？ B:如果你想當，一定有機會。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ juéde wǒ kěyǐ dāng lǎoshī ma? B: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng dāng, yídìng yǒu jīhuì.
examples.english: A: Do you think I can be a teacher? B: If you want to be one, you'll definitely have a chance.

examples.chinese: 我覺得當記者不容易，週末常常不能休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dāng jìzhě bù róngyì, zhōumò chángcháng bù néng xiūxí.
examples.english: I think being a reporter is not easy; often I can't rest on weekends.

examples.chinese: 結婚以前，他覺得工作最重要，現在他覺得家人最重要。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn yǐqián, tā juéde gōngzuò zuì zhòngyào, xiànzài tā juéde jiārén zuì zhòngyào.
examples.english: Before getting married, he felt work was most important; now he feels family is most important.

examples.chinese: 來台灣以後，每個週末我都有很多活動，覺得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, měi ge zhōumò wǒ dōu yǒu hěn duō huódòng, juéde hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have many activities every weekend and feel very happy.

examples.chinese: 這是我第一次來台灣，我覺得好開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì lái Táiwān, wǒ juéde hǎo kāixīn.
examples.english: This is my first time coming to Taiwan, I feel very happy.

examples.chinese: 帶這麼重的東西，走了兩個小時，我覺得很累。
examples.pinyin: Dài zhème zhòng de dōngxī, zǒu le liǎng ge xiǎoshí, wǒ juéde hěn lèi.
examples.english: Carrying such heavy things and walking for two hours, I feel very tired.

examples.chinese: 我覺得打球比跑步有意思，我常跟朋友一起打籃球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dǎqiú bǐ pǎobù yǒu yìsi, wǒ cháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: I think playing ball is more interesting than running; I often play basketball with friends.

examples.chinese: A:我覺得語言比數學有趣多了？ B:我同意你說的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ juéde yǔyán bǐ shùxué yǒuqù duō le? B: Wǒ tóngyì nǐ shuō de.
examples.english: A: I think languages are much more interesting than math? B: I agree with what you said.

examples.chinese: 大家都覺得做這個菜不難，很簡單。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu juéde zuò zhège cài bù nán, hěn jiǎndān.
examples.english: Everyone feels that making this dish is not hard; it's very simple.

examples.chinese: 今年的表演比去年的更有意思，我覺得你應該來看。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de biǎoyǎn bǐ qùnián de gèng yǒu yìsi, wǒ juéde nǐ yīnggāi lái kàn.
examples.english: This year's performance is even more interesting than last year's; I think you should come see it.

examples.chinese: 我住的房子不大，也沒有很多錢，可是家人都很愛我， 讓我覺得很幸福、很滿足。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de fángzi bù dà, yě méiyǒu hěn duō qián, kěshì jiārén dōu hěn ài wǒ, ràng wǒ juéde hěn xìngfú, hěn mǎnzú.
examples.english: The house I live in isn't big, and I don't have a lot of money, but my family all love me, which makes me feel very happy and satisfied.

examples.chinese:
小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。
我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi.
Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english:
Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes.
My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 李小姐的外語能力很強，也在歐洲工作過，我覺得這個翻譯工作很適合她。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě de wàiyǔ nénglì hěn qiáng, yě zài Ōuzhōu gōngzuò guò, wǒ juéde zhège fānyì gōngzuò hěn shìhé tā.
examples.english: Miss Li's foreign language ability is very strong, and she has also worked in Europe; I think this translation job is very suitable for her.

examples.chinese: 有人說，生孩子容易，養小孩難，你覺得呢？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, shēng háizi róngyì, yǎng xiǎohái nán, nǐ juéde ne?
examples.english: Some people say that giving birth to a child is easy, but raising a child is difficult. What do you think?

examples.chinese: 李先生從不吃泡麵、薯條、熱狗那樣的食物，因為他覺得不健康。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng cóngbù chī pàomiàn, shǔtiáo, règǒu nàyàng de shíwù, yīnwèi tā juéde bù jiànkāng.
examples.english: Mr. Li never eats foods like instant noodles, French fries, or hot dogs, because he thinks they are unhealthy.

examples.chinese:
我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。
我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo.
Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.
examples.english:
I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good.
My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that.

examples.chinese:
小陳很孝順，每個週末都去安養院陪父親聊天、散步，一點兒都不覺得辛苦。
孝順父母的方法很多，最簡單的就是不讓他們擔心、生氣。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Chén hěn xiàoshùn, měi gè zhōumò dōu qù ānyǎngyuàn péi fùqīn liáotiān, sànbù, yīdiǎnr dōu bù juéde xīnkǔ.
Xiàoshùn fùmǔ de fāngfǎ hěn duō, zuì jiǎndān de jiùshì bù ràng tāmen dānxīn, shēngqì.
examples.english:
Xiao Chen is very filial; every weekend he goes to the nursing home to chat and take walks with his father, and doesn't feel the least bit tired.
There are many ways to be filial to parents; the simplest is to not make them worry or get angry.

examples.chinese: 歐先生有閱讀的障礙，就算一篇極短的文章，讀起來也覺得很困難。
examples.pinyin: Ōu xiānsheng yǒu yuèdú de zhàng'ài, jiùsuàn yī piān jí duǎn de wénzhāng, dú qǐlái yě juéde hěn kùnnán.
examples.english: Mr. Ou has a reading obstacle; even a very short article feels difficult for him to read.

examples.chinese:
我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。
金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú.
Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english:
My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish.
Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 爺爺很喜歡在海邊釣魚，看著風景、吹著海風，他覺得舒服極了。
examples.pinyin: Yéye hěn xǐhuān zài hǎibiān diào yú, kàn zhe fēngjǐng, chuī zhe hǎifēng, tā juéde shūfu jí le.
examples.english: Grandpa really likes fishing by the sea; looking at the scenery and feeling the sea breeze, he feels extremely comfortable.

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 小何穿著綠色牛仔褲、紅襯衫，再戴上藍色的帽子，我覺得這些顏色配在一起很醜。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hé chuānzhe lǜsè niúzǎikù, hóng chènshān, zài dài shàng lánsè de màozi, wǒ juéde zhèxiē yánsè pèi zài yīqǐ hěn chǒu.
examples.english: Xiǎo Hé is wearing green jeans, a red shirt, and then puts on a blue hat; I think these colors paired together are very ugly.

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的運動服在夜市賣五百元，可是在百貨公司賣兩千元，你覺得合理嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de yùndòngfú zài yèshì mài wǔbǎi yuán, kěshì zài bǎihuò gōngsī mài liǎngqiān yuán, nǐ juéde hélǐ ma?
examples.english: This brand of sportswear sells for five hundred yuan at the night market, but sells for two thousand yuan at the department store—do you think that's reasonable?

examples.chinese: 我覺得馬小姐找不到工作的原因不是自己的條件不夠好，是他太缺乏自信了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Mǎ xiǎojiě zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò de yuányīn bùshì zìjǐ de tiáojiàn bù gòu hǎo, shì tā tài quēfá zìxìn le.
examples.english: I think the reason Miss Ma can't find a job is not that her own qualifications aren't good enough, but that she lacks self-confidence too much.

examples.chinese: 我覺得減少工作，增加有意義的休閒活動，這樣的生活比較充實。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde jiǎnshǎo gōngzuò, zēngjiā yǒu yìyì de xiūxián huódòng, zhèyàng de shēnghuó bǐjiào chōngshí.
examples.english: I think reducing work and increasing meaningful leisure activities—this kind of life is more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯覺得最近身體的毛病不少，可是說也奇怪，醫生檢查後都說他很正常。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo juéde zuìjìn shēntǐ de máobìng bù shǎo, kěshì shuō yě qíguài, yīshēng jiǎnchá hòu dōu shuō tā hěn zhèngcháng.
examples.english: Uncle Lin feels that he has quite a few health problems recently, but strange to say, after the doctor's examination, they all say he is very normal.

examples.chinese: 要是你覺得這盤菜的味道太淡了，可以加一點醬料。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ juéde zhè pán cài de wèidào tài dàn le, kěyǐ jiā yìdiǎn jiàngliào.
examples.english: If you feel this dish's flavor is too light, you can add a little sauce.

examples.chinese:
站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。
「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin:
Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le.
Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english:
The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow.
Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

examples.chinese: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud.

examples.chinese: 大信覺得這個公司的薪水跟福利都不好，於是決定換工作。
examples.pinyin: Dàxìn juéde zhège gōngsī de xīnshuǐ gēn fúlì dōu bù hǎo, yúshì juédìng huàn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Daxin felt that this company's salary and benefits were both bad, so he decided to change jobs.

examples.chinese: 可是我覺得那裡有點兒遠，走路去太累了。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde nàlǐ yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, zǒulù qù tài lèi le.
examples.english: But I think it’s a bit far. It’s too tiring to get there on foot.

examples.chinese: 朋友常來找我，他們都覺得坐捷運來我家，又快又方便。
examples.pinyin: Péngyǒu cháng lái zhǎo wǒ, tāmen dōu juéde zuò jiéyùn lái wǒ jiā, yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn.
examples.english: My friends often visit me. They all think taking the MRT to my house is both fast and convenient.

examples.chinese: 妳胖了嗎？我不覺得啊，我跟妳一起去看。我也想去買今年夏天的新衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pàng le ma? Wǒ bù juéde a, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù kàn. Wǒ yě xiǎng qù mǎi jīnnián xiàtiān de xīn yīfu.
examples.english: Have you gained weight? I don’t think so. I can go check with you. I would like to buy the new summer collections.

examples.chinese: 妳覺得怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: What do you think?

examples.chinese: 我覺得有的舊東西很不錯，有的新東西也很有趣，我很喜歡看新車、新衣服，可是因為我的錢不多，所以我不常買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒude jiù dōngxi hěn búcuò, yǒude xīn dōngxi yě hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xīn chē, xīn yīfu, kěshì yīnwèi wǒ de qián bù duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng mǎi.
examples.english: I think some old stuff is good and some new ones are interesting. I like to check the new car, new clothes out, but I do not have much money, so I don’t buy them often.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有點兒難，我也不太懂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒudiǎnr nán, wǒ yě bú tài dǒng.
examples.english: It is a little bit difficult; I don’t quite understand them, either.

examples.chinese: 你覺得哪裡不舒服？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde nǎlǐ bù shūfu?
examples.english: Where are you uncomfortable? (What brings you here today?)

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

items.wordHook: 覺(feel) + 得(get) → you get a feeling, so 覺得 means to feel or think.

examples.chinese: A:請問你們有英文菜單嗎？ B:對不起，我們沒有。
examples.pinyin: A: Qǐngwèn nǐmen yǒu Yīngwén càidān ma? B: Duìbuqǐ, wǒmen méiyǒu.
examples.english: A: Excuse me, do you have an English menu? B: Sorry, we don't.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳很特別，沒有菜單。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng hěn tèbié, méiyǒu càidān.
examples.english: This restaurant is very special; it doesn't have a menu.

items.wordHook: 菜(dish) + 單(list) → a list of dishes, the menu.

examples.chinese: 他去過德國留學，難怪會說德文。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù guò Déguó liúxué, nánguài huì shuō Dévén.
examples.english: He has studied abroad in Germany; no wonder he can speak German.

examples.chinese: 弟弟昨天夜裡兩點才睡覺，難怪早上起不來。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi zuótiān yèlǐ liǎng diǎn cái shuìjiào, nánguài zǎoshang qǐ bù lái.
examples.english: My younger brother didn't go to sleep until two o'clock last night; no wonder he couldn't get up in the morning.

examples.chinese: 陳小姐的工作能力很強，難怪可以當老闆的助理。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, nánguài kěyǐ dāng lǎobǎn de zhùlǐ.
examples.english: Miss Chen's work ability is very strong; no wonder she can be the boss's assistant.

examples.chinese: 張小姐的個性活潑大方，難怪有很多朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě de gèxìng huópō dàfāng, nánguài yǒu hěn duō péngyou.
examples.english: Miss Zhang's personality is lively and generous; no wonder she has many friends.

examples.chinese:
小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。
有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo.
Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english:
Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today.
Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhuānguì de diànyuán bǐ gāngcái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng, nánguài shēngyì zhème chà.
examples.english: The clerk at this brand counter is even fiercer than the one at the previous store; no wonder business is so bad.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳不僅服務態度好，而且食物好吃又便宜，難怪大家都推薦我來嚐嚐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bùjǐn fúwù tàidù hǎo, érqiě shíwù hǎochī yòu piányi, nánguài dàjiā dōu tuījiàn wǒ lái chángchang.
examples.english: This restaurant not only has a good service attitude, but the food is also delicious and cheap; no wonder everyone recommended I come and try it.

examples.chinese:
李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。
今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin:
Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo.
Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english:
Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good.
Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 我哥哥開朗活潑、高大英俊，難怪有很多女生追求他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge kāilǎng huópō, gāodà yīngjùn, nánguài yǒu hěnduō nǚshēng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: My older brother is cheerful and lively, tall and handsome; no wonder many girls pursue him.

examples.chinese: 那家便利商店的地理位置非常好，停車也很方便，難怪生意那麼好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā biànlì shāngdiàn de dìlǐ wèizhì fēicháng hǎo, tíngchē yě hěn fāngbiàn, nánguài shēngyì nàme hǎo.
examples.english: That convenience store's geographical location is excellent, and parking is also very convenient; no wonder business is so good.

examples.chinese:
不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的。
那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
examples.pinyin:
Bùguǎn shì shéi, rúguǒ shīqù le qīn'ài de jiārén, yīdìng huì hěn shāngxīn, hěn tòngkǔ, zhè shì hěn zìrán de.
Nàge nǚ yǎnyuán yǎnxì de yàngzi hěn zìrán, yīdiǎn yě bù kuāzhāng, nánguài dǎoyǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english:
No matter who it is, if they lose a beloved family member, they will certainly be very sad and in great pain; this is very natural.
That actress's acting is very natural, not exaggerated at all; no wonder the director appreciates her.

examples.chinese:
我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。
經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī.
Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english:
My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of.
The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: 方小姐既活潑又漂亮，難怪不少男生想追求她。
examples.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě jì huópō yòu piàoliang, nánguài bùshǎo nánshēng xiǎng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: Miss Fang is both lively and pretty; no wonder many guys want to pursue her.

examples.chinese: 這座島的風景很美，旅館價格也很合理，難怪不少遊客年年都來這裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dǎo de fēngjǐng hěn měi, lǚguǎn jiàgé yě hěn hélǐ, nánguài bùshǎo yóukè niánnián dōu lái zhèlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: The scenery of this island is beautiful, and the hotel prices are also reasonable; no wonder many tourists come here to travel year after year.

examples.chinese: 顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Yán jiàoshòu duì Hànyǔ yǔfǎ yǒu hěn shēnrù de yánjiū, nánguài tā de yǔfǎ kè nàme shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Professor Yan has very profound research on Chinese grammar; no wonder his grammar class is so popular.

examples.chinese: 我跟朋友手機的式樣很接近，難怪我們常常拿錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyǒu shǒujī de shìyàng hěn jiējìn, nánguài wǒmen chángcháng ná cuò.
examples.english: My friend's and my cell phones are very similar in style; no wonder we often take the wrong one.

examples.chinese: 那位客人在地攤買東西揀來揀去，最後又不買，難怪老闆滿臉不高興的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi kèrén zài dìtān mǎi dōngxi jiǎn lái jiǎn qù, zuìhòu yòu bù mǎi, nánguài lǎobǎn mǎn liǎn bù gāoxìng de yàngzi.
examples.english: That customer kept picking and choosing while shopping at the street stall, and in the end didn’t buy anything; no wonder the owner looked unhappy.

examples.chinese: 花蓮太魯閣的確很漂亮，難怪每年都吸引許多觀光客去參觀。
examples.pinyin: Huālián Tàilǔgé dequè hěn piàoliang, nánguài měinián dōu xīyǐn xǔduō guānguāngkè qù cānguān.
examples.english: Hualien's Taroko Gorge is indeed very beautiful; no wonder it attracts many tourists to visit every year.

examples.chinese: 她在電子工廠上班，難怪拆機器的技術非常熟練。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài diànzǐ gōngchǎng shàngbān, nánguài chāi jīqì de jìshù fēicháng shúliàn.
examples.english: She works at an electronics factory, no wonder her skill in disassembling machines is very proficient.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的想法很不實際，他一直想找一份錢多、事少、離家近的工作，但這種工作很難找啊！
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xiǎngfǎ hěn bù shíjì, tā yīzhí xiǎng zhǎo yī fèn qián duō, shì shǎo, lí jiā jìn de gōngzuò, dàn zhè zhǒng gōngzuò hěn nán zhǎo a!
examples.english: My older brother's way of thinking is very impractical; he keeps wanting to find a job with lots of money, little work, and close to home, but that kind of job is hard to find!

examples.chinese:
理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。
著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin:
Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng.
Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english:
In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation.
The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 她是一個很實際的人，對愛情從來不抱著美好的想像。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī ge hěn shíjì de rén, duì àiqíng cónglái bù bàozhe měihǎo de xiǎngxiàng.
examples.english: She is a very practical person and has never held beautiful fantasies about love.

examples.chinese: 我採花的時候被刺了一下，不過還好不太痛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cǎi huā de shíhou bèi cì le yīxià, bùguò hái hǎo bù tài tòng.
examples.english: When I was picking flowers, I got pricked once, but fortunately it didn't hurt too much.

examples.chinese:
你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。
下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。
昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin:
Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le.
Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé.
Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english:
The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends.
After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam.
Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 像衝浪、滑雪那樣的戶外活動，又刺激又好玩，不用說，絕對能吸引青少年。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng chōnglàng, huáxuě nàyàng de hùwài huódòng, yòu cìjī yòu hǎowán, bùyòng shuō, juéduì néng xīyǐn qīngshàonián.
examples.english: Outdoor activities like surfing and skiing are both exciting and fun; needless to say, they can definitely attract teenagers.

examples.chinese:
我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。
金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú.
Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english:
My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish.
Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 小周才三十歲，就去過四十幾個國家，甚至去過一些又危險又刺激的地方，真是太酷了！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu cái sānshí suì, jiù qùguò sìshí jǐ gè guójiā, shènzhì qùguò yīxiē yòu wēixiǎn yòu cìjī de dìfāng, zhēn shì tài kù le!
examples.english: Xiao Zhou is only thirty years old, but has already been to over forty countries, and even some dangerous and exciting places—that's really so cool!

examples.chinese:
滑雪是很刺激的活動，需要很好的技巧。
李小姐受不了離婚的刺激，已經好幾天吃不好、睡不好了。
examples.pinyin:
Huáxuě shì hěn cìjī de huódòng, xūyào hěn hǎo de jìqiǎo.
Lǐ xiǎojiě shòu bù liǎo líhūn de cìjī, yǐjīng hǎo jǐ tiān chī bù hǎo, shuì bù hǎo le.
examples.english:
Skiing is a very exciting activity that requires good skills.
Miss Li couldn't handle the shock of divorce, and has been unable to eat or sleep well for several days.

examples.chinese: 當別人遇到不愉快的事時，應該避免說些刺激他的話。
examples.pinyin: Dāng biérén yùdào bù yúkuài de shì shí, yīnggāi bìmiǎn shuō xiē cìjī tā de huà.
examples.english: When others encounter unpleasant things, one should avoid saying things that irritate them.

examples.chinese: 公司不斷推銷新型電子產品，通常是為了刺激客戶購買。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī bùduàn tuīxiāo xīnxíng diànzǐ chǎnpǐn, tōngcháng shì wèile cìjī kèhù gòumǎi.
examples.english: Companies constantly promote new types of electronic products, usually in order to stimulate customers to buy.

items.wordHook: The 朿(thorn) is the point; the 刂(knife) is the force that drives it in — 刺(stab).

examples.chinese: 以前學校規定女學生的髮型都要一樣，而且長度不能超過耳朵。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián xuéxiào guīdìng nǚ xuéshēng de fàxíng dōu yào yīyàng, érqiě chángdù bùnéng chāoguò ěrduo.
examples.english: In the past, the school required that female students' hairstyles all be the same, and the length could not exceed the ears.

examples.chinese: 從過去到現在，尊敬長輩一直是華人最重視的傳統觀念之一。
examples.pinyin: Cóng guòqù dào xiànzài, zūnjìng zhǎngbèi yīzhí shì Huárén zuì zhòngshì de chuántǒng guānniàn zhī yī.
examples.english: From the past to the present, respecting elders has always been one of the traditional values that Chinese people value most.

examples.chinese: 包著紅豆餡，裹著花生粉的麻糬，是臺灣著名的傳統甜點。
examples.pinyin: Bāo zhe hóngdòu xiàn, guǒ zhe huāshēngfěn de máshǔ, shì Táiwān zhùmíng de chuántǒng tiándiǎn.
examples.english: Mochi wrapped with red bean filling and coated with peanut powder is a famous traditional Taiwanese dessert.

examples.chinese: 按照中國的傳統觀念，女人未嫁時得聽父親的話，嫁了人之後就得聽丈夫的。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào Zhōngguó de chuántǒng guānniàn, nǚrén wèi jià shí děi tīng fùqīn de huà, jià le rén zhīhòu jiù děi tīng zhàngfu de.
examples.english: According to traditional Chinese concepts, before a woman marries she must listen to her father's words, and after she marries she must listen to her husband's.

examples.chinese: 有些國家的傳統戲劇常利用影子和燈光效果來表演。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā de chuántǒng xìjù cháng lìyòng yǐngzi hé dēngguāng xiàoguǒ lái biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: Traditional theater in some countries often uses shadows and lighting effects to perform.

examples.chinese: 他今天去傳統市場買菜，特別做了拿手菜招待好友。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi cài, tèbié zuò le náshǒucài zhāodài hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: Today he went to the traditional market to buy groceries and especially made his specialty dishes to entertain good friends.

examples.chinese: 中國人看傳統戲劇時都喜歡準備一盤瓜子，邊吃邊欣賞。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguórén kàn chuántǒng xìjù shí dōu xǐhuān zhǔnbèi yī pán guāzǐ, biān chī biān xīnshǎng.
examples.english: When Chinese people watch traditional opera, they all like to prepare a plate of melon seeds and enjoy them while watching.

examples.chinese: 臺灣人常用花生、紅豆做傳統點心。
examples.pinyin: Táiwānrén cháng yòng huāshēng, hóngdòu zuò chuántǒng diǎnxīn.
examples.english: Taiwanese people often use peanuts and red beans to make traditional snacks.

examples.chinese: 那位服裝設計師相當喜愛十八世紀時的歐洲傳統風格。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúzhuāng shèjìshī xiāngdāng xǐ'ài shíbā shìjì shí de Ōuzhōu chuántǒng fēnggé.
examples.english: That fashion designer quite loves the traditional European style of the 18th century.

examples.chinese:
時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。
在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin:
Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le.
Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english:
Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly.
In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 現代人往往以網路傳訊息，代替傳統寫信或打電話的方式。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén wǎngwǎng yǐ wǎnglù chuán xiāoxi, dàitì chuántǒng xiě xìn huò dǎ diànhuà de fāngshì.
examples.english: Modern people often use the internet to send messages, replacing the traditional ways of writing letters or making phone calls.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái, zhège chuántǒng guānniàn zài Táiwān yǐjīng mànman gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: For Chinese people, only by studying well can one have a beautiful future; this traditional concept has already gradually changed in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 臺灣南部不僅天氣好、旅遊景點多，還有各式各樣的傳統小吃，很值得去走走。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù bùjǐn tiānqì hǎo, lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn duō, hái yǒu gè shì gè yàng de chuántǒng xiǎochī, hěn zhídé qù zǒuzǒu.
examples.english: Southern Taiwan not only has good weather and many touring spots, but also has all kinds of traditional snacks; it's well worth a visit.

examples.chinese: 照華人的傳統習慣，女人生完孩子就要坐月子，一直在家休息到孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, nǚrén shēng wán háizi jiù yào zuòyuèzi, yīzhí zài jiā xiūxi dào háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: According to Chinese tradition, after a woman gives birth, she must practice confinement, resting at home until the baby is one month old.

examples.chinese: 何小姐習慣去傳統市場買水果，而且都跟同一個攤販買。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě xíguàn qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi shuǐguǒ, érqiě dōu gēn tóng yí ge tānfàn mǎi.
examples.english: Miss He is used to buying fruit at the traditional market, and she always buys from the same street vendor.

examples.chinese: 為了參加同事的婚禮，我打算當天穿上很有特色的中國傳統服裝。
examples.pinyin: Wèile cānjiā tóngshì de hūnlǐ, wǒ dǎsuàn dāngtiān chuān shàng hěn yǒu tèsè de Zhōngguó chuántǒng fúzhuāng.
examples.english: In order to attend my colleague's wedding, I plan to wear very distinctive traditional Chinese clothing on that day.

examples.chinese:
小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡。
老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Huáng yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng qián, wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi.
Lǎobǎn qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu huílái, mǎile Hélán chuántǒng de diǎnxin sòng gěi dàjiā, jiào wǒmen qù zhùlǐ nàlǐ lǐng.
examples.english:
Xiao Huang is going to the convenience store to withdraw money; I asked him to buy me a cup of coffee.
The boss came back from a trip to Europe and bought traditional Dutch snacks to give to everyone, and told us to pick them up from the assistant.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺的想法很傳統，除夕一定要大家回去吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye de xiǎngfǎ hěn chuántǒng, Chúxī yídìng yào dàjiā huíqù chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: My grandfather's thinking is very traditional; on New Year's Eve, he insists that everyone go back to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 傳統私立高中有許多規定，在管理學生方面相當嚴格。
examples.pinyin: Chuántǒng sīlì gāozhōng yǒu xǔduō guīdìng, zài guǎnlǐ xuéshēng fāngmiàn xiāngdāng yángé.
examples.english: Traditional private high schools have many rules and are quite strict in terms of managing students.

items.wordHook: A serene, awakened 亻(person) who turns away from 弗(not) earthly illusions to achieve peace is a 佛(Buddha).
A motorized vehicle powered by 摩(scour) friction and 托(raise) wheels like a 車(car): 摩托車 means motorcycle.
An 目(eye) watches 青(blue-green) glow → the round 睛(eyeball).
